errors.evidence: The description states that the line dropped to its lowest point in 2012, but the figure clearly shows this minimum value is reached around the year 2014.
The chart shows the rebound after the minimum point occurs around 2015, not in 2013.
The value of the rebound after the lowest point is approximately 3.1, not 3.24 as stated. The stated value is a significant overestimation.
